briefdescription.para: Relative positions at which 'if' cases may be inserted.
Stores a list of preprocessing directives.
Insert 'if' directives to close a context.
Insert 'if' directives to open a context.
Sanitizes a string for insertion into a C-style comment.
Returns the 'if' case of the parent directive of the given case, if any.

detaileddescription.para: For example, let 'c' be as marked below:
if A // ... #elif B // Associated with some case, 'b' // ... if C // Associated with input case 'c'
Then, this routine returns the case 'b'.

briefdescription.para: Returns the 'if ...' that opens the directive to which this case belongs.

detaileddescription.para: For example, let 'c' be as marked below:
if A // Associated with some case, 'a' // ... #elif B // ... #elif C // Associated with input case, 'c' // ...

simplesect.para: A non-NULL result, given a non-NULL input case.

briefdescription.para: Generates PreprocessingInfo objects for use when 'closing' an 'if' directive context.
Generates PreprocessingInfo objects for use when 'opening' an 'if' directive context.
Interprets (converts) an open/close context's relative position into a PreprocessingInfo::RelativePositionType position.
Inserts preprocessing info at the 'PreprocessingInfo::inside' position of the given target statement.
Returns 'true' if the given statement will not be unparsed.
Inserts the given preprocessing info at the front of the first statement in b.

simplesect.para: b is non-NULL and has at least 1 statement in it.

This code handles a somewhat esoteric special case in which the statement 's' will not be unparsed, and so any preprocessing information attached to it would also go unparsed. This occurred in CompileTests/Cxx_tests/test2001_09.C, where an implicit return statement (represented explicitly in the tree but unparsed) was being outlined.

briefdescription.para: Inserts preprocessing info objects into a basic block.
Preprocessor phase to break-up any preprocessing control structure that may straddle the boundaries of a basic block.
